creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Owner's request, 2026-10-25: in a group's conversation, a name drawn in its own color is quicker to spot when looking for one agent's messages.

Proposed shape, to settle before building:
- The color comes from the participant's identity, the pane id for a pane (never reused, unlike a callsign) and the name for a joined participant, hashed into a fixed palette. So an agent has the same color in every group and every window, with nothing stored.
- The sidebar already colors every callsign with the one accent color (Sidebar.swift, the callsign label). Drawing it in the agent's color instead ties the two views together without adding a new colored element.
- The palette must stay clear of the agent-state colors and the machine dots, so that a name's color is never read as a state.
- @human and @muster get fixed colors of their own, outside the palette.
- Color only ever adds to the name text, never replaces it.

Open: with a palette of around 8, two members of one group will sometimes share a color. Accept that, or pick per group, which avoids clashes but gives an agent different colors in different groups.
title: 🎨 Each participant's name in a conversation has a stable color, shared with its callsign in the sidebar
